terms.comment: In Justinian’s Code a public almshouse for poor old people (Lewis & Short).

terms.gloss: an infirmary, a house where the sick are nursed
terms.comment: Greek νοσοκομεῖον, a hospital or infirmary (Lewis & Short); it suits a nursing home in the older sense, a small house for nursing the sick. For a home for the old, gerontocomīum, which Traupman himself gives for old-age home.

sources: Lewis & Short: gerontocomium · Lewis & Short: nosocomium
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 65.
